derived_checks.assessment: Implied rate is ~16% above the county's illustrative 1.1488% TRA. Plausible causes: a TRA with more bond/special-assessment load, or a special assessment line not broken out. Cannot be confirmed without the bill.

Implied rate is ~81% above San Francisco's published FY2025-26 secured rate of 1.18268325%. A ten-year consistent pattern points to real parcel-level charges (special assessments / bonds / a second parcel on the same bill) rather than a transcription error, but it cannot be confirmed without the bill.
